title: Keep the rail's own-page links on this site
description: Bridges two gaps in cat-harness's foreign-site rail for a folio that is the root of its own site (bean ihris-yvow): before the rail it re-roots ihris's own declared pages in the navbar data under /ihris/, so the scope keeps them; after the rail it points the icon row's data root at each page's own site root, so links and the beans count resolve on the deploy serving the page (live or staging), while the chrome's code still loads from the platform.
